title: Abbas sa beta dede
body:
Abbas sa beta dede
aise farzand ke khatir hai tamanna-e-ali
Jo bahadur ho, mujahid ho, wafadaar bhi ho
Ya rab mere ya rab ya rab mere ya rab
<<MINI>>
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
Jab mere ghar me alam hai to alamdaar bhi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ek jari chahiye tarikh-e-shuja-at ke liye
Karbala me mere shabbir ki nusrat ke liye Aur namoos-e-payambar ki hifaazat ke liye
<<MINI>>
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
Jab mere ghar me alam hai to alamdaar bhi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shukr sad shukr tera shabbar-o-shabbir diye
Betiyaan ki hai ata zainab-o-kulsoom mujhe
Baad iske meri bas ek dua ke badle
<<MINI>>
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
Jab mere ghar me alam hai to alamdaar bhi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aaina sabr-o-shujaat ka bana na mera
Hu bahu meri hi tasweer ho baccha mera
Usko dekhoon to nazar aaye sarapa mera
<<MINI>>
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
Jab mere ghar me alam hai to alamdaar bhi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Koi be-yar-o-madadgaar agar hojaye
Iltaja behre madad apni zabaan par laye
Mujko awaaz koi de wo madad ko aaye
<<MINI>>
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
Jab mere ghar me alam hai to alamdaar bhi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
5.  Zindagi jiski guzar jaye alamdaari me
Apne baazoo bhi kata de jo fidakaari me
Sabse aage nazar aaye jo wafadaari me
<<MINI>>
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
Jab mere ghar me alam hai to alamdaar bhi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Sabko sairab karo aisi sakhawat dekar
Umar bhar ke liye bhai ki ita-at-dekar
Uske haathon me mera zor-e-shuja-at dekar
<<MINI>>
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
Jab mere ghar me alam hai to alamdaar bhi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Naam uska ho jin hoton pe wahan pyas na ho
Koi umeed na toote koi be aas na ho
Yaad karke use tanhai ka ehsaas na ho
<<MINI>>
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
Jab mere ghar me alam hai to alamdaar bhi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aye kaleem ho gaye maqbool dua-e-haider
Murtaza usko kaha fatema zehra ne pisar
Aarzoo ki thi ali ne jo huzoor-e-dawar
<<MINI>>
Ya ilahi mujhe abbas sa beta dede
Jab mere ghar me alam hai to alamdaar bhi ho
